_comment: Config Editor's built-in example-presets catalogue (Show example presets... / Insert ALL). Each entry: 'description' (shown in the popup) + 'preset' (the actual presets[<name>] value, inserted verbatim into the Presets JSON field). Edit/add entries here - no Python change needed.

ct_soft_tissue.description: Typical CT soft-tissue window (abdomen/pelvis general use).

ct_bone.description: Wide CT window for bone detail.

ct_lung.description: Very wide, low-center CT window for lung parenchyma.

ct_brain.description: Narrow CT window for brain parenchyma.

ct_angio.description: CT window tuned for contrast-enhanced vessels.

mri_auto.description: Let Slicer auto-window any MRI sequence; also smooths (interpolate).

mri_t1.description: Auto window + interpolation + grayscale, for T1-weighted MRI.

mri_t2_flair.description: Auto window + interpolation + grayscale, for T2/FLAIR MRI.

pet_hot_metal.description: Hot-metal PET colormap at partial opacity, meant as an overlay.

label_overlay.description: Generic distinguishable colors for a label/segmentation-style overlay.

red_overlay.description: Deer-study 'rel' example: red colormap + threshold + a narrow width/level window, semi-transparent.

green_overlay.description: Simple green, half-opacity overlay - handy for a second label image.
